main_text.head: APPENDIX.

p.i: Exhibens duos Tractatus, sive libellos, quorum mentio supra facta est, in prima parte hujus disputationis, cap. VIII. pagina 48. 49. quosque sub Athanasii nomine falso editos (Athan. T. 2. pag. 309. & 325.) Patriarcha Photius Theodoreto, veluti vero auctori, vindicat atque asserit Bibliothecæ suæ Codice XLVI. ubi quæ exstant ejus hac de re verba, hic Lectori inprimis exhibere placuit.

main_text.head: PHOTIVS Bibliothecæ Cod. XLVI.
main_text.p: ΘΕΟΔΩΡΗΤΟΥ Ἐπισκόπου κύρου λόγοι ιζ. πρὸς Ἀρφόρυς θέσεις.
THEODORETI EPISCOPI Cyri contra Haereticos libri XXVII. & Eranistæ libri III.
{a}Ἀνεγνώσθη Θεοδωρήτου Ἐπισκόπου κύρου, λόγοι ιζ. πρὸς Ἀρφόρυς θέσεις.
Lecti Theodoreti Episcopi Cyri libri septem & viginti, adversus varias propositiones.
{a} Episcopatu adeptus A.D. 423. decessit post annum 465.

page.notes: The Greek text is set in a Greek typeface and is only approximately reproduced; the Greek in the left column (title and first lines) is hard to read on the scan and may contain errors. The marginal note at left reads "Episcopatu adepto / A.D. 423. / decessit / post annum 465". The two columns are parallel; the left is Greek, the right Latin. The ornamental band at top and the page number were printed. Catchword: "Pri-" is the hyphenated start of the next page, shown at the foot of the right column.
